title: SEC3: Reduce nesting in process_update receipt logic
description: In kith-chat/src/message.rs lines 442-456, the receipt enqueue path has 3 levels of nesting: if let Ok(Some(msg)), if sender_id check, if let Ok(Some(contact)). Consider flattening with early returns or extracting a helper function to improve readability. Current structure is correct but could be clearer.
